name: Atlas 950 SuperPoD product page
notes: PRIMARY VENDOR SOURCE. 44OU compute cabinet with 64x 950DT NPU: 64x 96 GB on-chip memory, 4.0 TB/s, 114.1 PFLOPS mxFP4 / 58.8 PFLOPS mxFP8-HiF8 / 31.1 PFLOPS FP16-BF16, 64 x 1.68 TB/s bidirectional UB Link. Scales to 1024 NPUs at 1.72 PB/s UB Link with 256 TB unified global memory addressing, ~100 kW liquid cooled. The 256 TB unified global memory claim is the single most consequential number here for anyone modelling Ascend memory semantics.
